title: Brave browser profiles
whyItMatters: Brave profiles hold separate browsing identities and saved data. Their count shows whether the browser was used for more than one identity.
notes: Chromium layout without the extra User Data segment found on Windows. Preferences marks a real profile (Default, Profile 1, ...).

cleanup.exportFirst: In Brave export bookmarks from the bookmark manager, and save any passwords you keep in its password manager.
cleanup.signOut: In Brave open the sync settings and choose Leave sync chain, so the sync account stops trusting this Mac.
steps: Close every Brave window so the profile files are not in use.
Move Brave Browser to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the Brave-Browser folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Brave profile on this Mac: history, cookies, saved logins and extensions. Synced data stays in the sync chain.
cleanup.source: Brave Help Center, Understanding Brave Sync: https://support.brave.app/hc/en-us/articles/360059793111-Understanding-Brave-Sync
